digest.component_or_area: dependency graph resolver and link comparability logic
propositions: The blocking-link resolver incorrectly decides comparability from ticket TYPE_TIER instead of from structural parent hierarchy, allowing tickets to create dependencies with incomparable types and ancestors to block descendants.
Self-blocking and mis-escalated edges already written under the type-tier rule distort ready/next-batch scheduling and cascade claims, requiring store-wide detection and repair.
The resolver must enforce an invariant that no blocking edge can exist between a ticket and its own ancestor or descendant, by any path into the resolver.

Escalation of cross-subtree links must remain transparent to callers via auto-escalation and unchanged redirect records, while comparability is recomputed from nearest common ancestor instead of type tier.
